name: sticks_web_composer
description: Active Next.js SDK list for the sticks-web shell (composed by The-Rokct-Protocol core/utils/nextjs/sdk_composer.py)
_comment: The Sticks website's composition (RokctAI/sticks-web, .rokct/config/app_type 'sticks'). Like southriver-web it has no backend and no registry template: this committed file IS the composition, and `scripts/compose.sh refresh` composes from it and re-pins every entry (SDK_ECOSYSTEM.md hard invariant 9: the kernel first). agent_sdk is home through its app_type.sticks block ("common": false, The-Rokct-Protocol's Next.js installer), so only the Sticks landing composes - none of rokct.ai's chat, register or opportunities. No auth_sdk: nobody signs in on this site; the Sticks app is where people work.

sdks.name: telemetry_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of telemetry/nextjs/install.py at core@7bb8d65f (1079 bytes), computed at spawn by the factory's seed_composer.py; required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. `scripts/compose.sh refresh` re-pins from the registry.
sdks._comment: Mandatory in every Next.js composition (SDK_ECOSYSTEM.md hard invariant 9): the delivery-policy seam owner, always first.

sdks.name: base_sdk

sdks._comment: The platform kernel: app/services/base, the landing host and its registries, the admin and manager shells. Every other Next.js SDK 'requires' files it installs.

sdks._comment: Home SDK through app_type.sticks (agent_sdk 1.25.0): app/page.tsx is the Sticks landing (concept artifact PDm9514Z16ypx8dk3oQQtq) in the concept's colours, with its crowd picture under public/sticks/ and the site metadata and the Back to top style registered in base_sdk's registries. Pinned to RokctAI/agent main, which includes agent#567 (agent_sdk 1.25.0).
